text:
maya_prod: FYI weve opened an early Dedicated pool for A800 GPUs in ap-northeast-3 (Osaka) + a small H100 capacity top-up in eu-central-1c. Targeting customers with strict latency/regulatory needs in APAC and EMEA.

devin_infra: Rollout numbers: Osaka = 6 A800s across a single rack (soft per-account cap = 2). eu-central-1c = +6 H100s added (soft cap unchanged). To request >soft-cap, submit a quota request under "Dedicated GPU - A800" or "Dedicated GPU - H100" with expected tokens/sec and peak seq len. Typical review 48-96h.

jess_sales: Any migration incentives or pilot slots we can offer to close deals this month?

maya_prod: Pilot slots: two for validated partners in Osaka, one-time migration assistance available on a case-by-case basis. No blanket discounts; AMs can request credits via partner-ops for strategic deals.

infra-bot: Telemetry snapshot: ap-northeast-3 p95 token-latency 65ms, p99 120ms, avg gpu util 22%. eu-central-1c p95 46ms, p99 78ms, avg util 63%. No hardware faults.

omar_ops: Note: A800 images need kernel module v2.1+ and runtime v2.5.1. We'll gate public migrations until validation passes in staging. Scheduled quick maintenance Mon 2026-04-06 01:00-02:00 UTC for driver tuning on Osaka rack; cross-region routing will minimize impact.

support-bot: Support reminder: include quota request ID and preferred region in tickets. Tag tickets with "dedicated-osaka" or "dedicated-euc-c" for faster routing. For pilot requests, include partner name and timeline.

devin_infra: Adding API reservation flags: region_strict: boolean, and priority_tier: ["standard","pilot","enterprise"]. Also will add an alert (pager) if any Dedicated pool in a region drops below 15% spare capacity.

maya_prod: Action items: (1) eng-infra add pager + API flags @devin_infra, (2) ops publish driver/compat checklist and maintenance window @omar_ops, (3) sales/AMs start outreach to top prospects and log pilot requests in the partner tracker @jess_sales.

jess_sales: Starting outreach now. Will update partner tracker and DM for pilot approvals.

maya_prod: We'll hold external marketing until we validate 48h of stable telemetry post-maintenance. If you see odd evictions or routing issues, reply here and tag @omar_ops. Thanks everyone :tada:
